hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && U=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') && T=$(grep -rln 'TEMP-DEBUG' frontend/src 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') && if [ "$U" -gt 0 ] || [ "$T" -gt 0 ]; then jq -n --arg msg "REPO STATE: uncommitted=$U files | TEMP-DEBUG markers=$T (review before next turn)" '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "Stop", additionalContext: $msg}, systemMessage: ("📋 " + $msg)}'; fi
